first_file_schema.data: 长度 3 的 MATLAB struct array，对应 01T、02T、03T

run_fields.X: float64 [samples, 6]；前 3 列 EEG 双极导联，后 3 列 EOG，只允许前 3 列进入分类器
run_fields.trial: 每个 trial 的样本锚点，MATLAB 1-based；使用前应显式转为 0-based
run_fields.artifacts: uint8；每 trial 0/1 专家伪迹标记

channel_semantics.confirmed: 原始说明写的是 three bipolar recordings (C3, Cz, C4)，并说明三对双极电极的距离及前后位置会随受试者略有不同；Fz 是 EEG ground。EOG 才是三个单极通道、左乳突参考。
channel_semantics.risk: C3/Cz/C4 是双极 recording 的简写，不等于三个标准 10-20 单极电位。把它们直接映射到 LaBraM/EEGPT 的 C3/Cz/C4 channel embedding 会造成物理语义错配。MOABB 页面自动元数据显示 left-mastoid reference，与原始 PDF 对 EEG 的描述不一致，应以原始 PDF 为准。
channel_semantics.foundation_model_route: 只进入单独的 learned-channel-adapter 轨。EEGPT 官方实现用可训练 1x1 Conv 将 3 路映射为 C5/C3/C1/Cz/C2/C4/C6，再冻结 encoder；这不是纯 frozen feature + linear head。

EEGPT.status: 论文声明的 checkpoint pretraining list 未含 BCIC-2B；Table 1 将其明确列为 downstream
EEGPT.confidence: confirmed for the paper-declared corpus; not a forensic proof about every future checkpoint

LaBraM.status: Appendix D 的完整声明清单含 BCI Competition IV-1，未列 IV-2b
LaBraM.confidence: not listed in the paper-declared pretraining corpus; do not shorten to an absolute ‘clean’ claim

recommended_locked_protocol.split: per subject: aggregate sessions 01T+02T+03T train; 04E+05E test. No test-session normalization, feature fitting, threshold choice or model selection.
recommended_locked_protocol.window: anchor at MAT trial sample; [0,4.0 s) after cue onset as the fixed v0.1 epoch. Record that screening and feedback sessions have different visual-feedback context.
recommended_locked_protocol.channels: X[:,0:3] only; preserve bipolar voltages; no CAR; EOG excluded from prediction
recommended_locked_protocol.preprocessing: recorded online 0.5-100 Hz plus 50 Hz notch already exists; any additional 4-40 Hz offline filter/resampling must be identical across train/test and fitted operations must be train-only
recommended_locked_protocol.artifact_policy: artifact-free primary result to match the original competition evaluation; all-trial sensitivity result alongside it, both with exact denominators
recommended_locked_protocol.metrics: per-subject balanced accuracy, macro F1 and Cohen kappa; report mean across 9 subjects plus all 9 values and a subject bootstrap descriptive interval
track_labels: learned channel adapter + frozen foundation encoder
prohibited_claims: 不把双极导联写成标准单极 C3/Cz/C4
不把 adapter 轨写成无训练 zero-shot/frozen linear probe
不与 BNCI2014-001 四分类 LOSO 分数直接排序
